meta.name: Love Between Fairy and Devil
meta.description:
When a low-ranked fairy accidentally resurrects a powerful demon, their fates become cosmically entangled as the world is thrown into turmoil.

Complete series. On your server: S1 36/36

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Xiao Lanhua is just a low-ranked fairy. But when her crush is in trouble, she makes a bold move that unwittingly leads her to face a notorious demon.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Trapped in a sealed dimension, Xiao Lanhua and the infamous demon try to figure out an escape plan. Dongfang Qingcang revisits his past defeat.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: With their fates cosmically linked, Dongfang Qingcang races to save Xiao Lanhua from danger. Changheng continues the search for a missing prisoner.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The magic bond between the fairy and demon proves to be more powerful than expected. Oblivious to Dongfang's identity, Xiao Lanhua keeps annoying him.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Dongfang Qingcang makes efforts to heal Xiao Lanhua's injury. The two grow closer as they are increasingly used to each other's company.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: To get closer to Changheng, Xiao Lanhua joins a qualifying test for fairies. When a saboteur steps in, the exam goes wildly off the rails.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Xiao Lanhua's caring heart makes her a standout in the fairy exam. A chat unexpectedly stirs up Dongfang Qingcang's emotions.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A rejection from Changheng leaves Xiao Lanhua shattered. While fleeing from his foes, Dongfang Qingcang makes a daring move that reveals his feelings.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Xiao Lanhua's connection to the wanted prisoner makes her a public enemy. When Qingcang rushes to help, he is confronted about his real identity.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Taken to a different world as a prisoner, Xiao Lanhua struggles to process her revelation about the real identity of Dongfang Qingcang.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Xiao Lanhua's risky move puts her in a tricky situation. Assuming a new identity, she entangles herself in a series of dangerous political games.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Xiao Lanhua and Qingcang scramble to hide their secret identities. Meanwhile, Changheng's rescue plan goes horribly wrong.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Stuck in an awkward situation, Xiao Lanhua and Dongfang Qingcang have no choice but to face Changheng as someone else.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Jieli pays a visit to a good friend. As their bond grows deeper, Xiao Lanhua gets a glimpse of Dongfang Qingcang's tragic past.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Jieli grows closer to someone who understands her upbringing. Against Qingcang's warning, Xiao Lanhua unwittingly walks into a trap.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Qingcang begins to notice a small but vital change in himself. This sudden shift brought in cruel consequences to people around him.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: To find out the truth about Qingcang's childhood, Xiao Lanhua ventures into a tabooed palace and summons a deity from the past.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The father-son encounter leaves Dongfang Qingcang shattered. After revisiting his trauma, Qingcang learns to express his newfound emotions.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: A shocking discovery sends Changheng to the human realm, where Xiao Lanhua and Dongfang Qingcang also happen to end up in.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Several eternal beings embark on their own adventures in the human realm, where Qingcang approaches a special woman marked by a mythical seal.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Xiao Lanhua accidentally disrupts a destined encounter, leaving several people's souls in dire peril. Luckily, there are ways to remedy the situation.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: As Xiao Lanhua and Dongfang Qingcang make detailed plans to clean up their mess, the fates they derailed become even more convoluted.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: To assuage Xiao Run's feelings for Xiao Lanhua, Qingcang makes an abrupt announcement. A pretend couple spend some genuine good time together.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Qingcang's plan is obstructed by an idea from Jieli. Meanwhile, Xiao Lanhua struggles to understand her own feelings toward two eternal beings.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Xiao Lanhua and Xie Wanqing are marrying their matches in the human realm, but a series of conspiracies end up breaking out on their big day.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: As Xiao Lanhua steps in to protect Dongfang Qingcang, her past Iife is unexpectedly revealed. Yun Zhongjun İssues a cruel order.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: After the experience in the human realm, two nemeses develop a complicated friendship. Changheng's loyalty is rewarded with a draconian punishment.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: To prove his love, Dongfang Qingcang goes through gruesome tortures for Xiao Lanhua, who also makes a daring proposal despite overwhelming objections.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Under a painful test, Xiao Lanhua proves her unwavering Conviction. Meanwhile, Xunfeng's resentment toward Xiao Lanhua builds up to a boiling point.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: In a world of illusion, an eternal being attempts to corrupt Qingcang's mind. The identity of Xiao Lanhua's past life is revealed before her eyes.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Betrayed and captured, a determined Xiao Lanhua makes a tearful decision to save her loved ones at a costly price.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Mulling over his tragic loss, Dongfang Qingcang resigns himself to living in a dream dimension. Meanwhile, Changheng delivers him a message of hope.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: A tragedy reverses its course due to Qingcang's tremendous efforts. But the returned lover is nothing like whom he used to know.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Teamed up to confront a powerful enemy, two estranged siblings rebuild their bond at long last. Xiyun realizes a deviant deity is at large.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: To end his master's misery, Rong Hao resorts to an extreme act. Meanwhile, Dongfang Qingcang makes a plea to Xiyun–for old time's sake.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Qingcang and Xiao Lanhua team up to save the three realms from a deviant god, but one of them must pay the ultimate price.
